newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight systems Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight systems Wednesday.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements on Wednesday, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York confirmed.

The current two-week maintenance period ends on Wednesday and economists said a permanent add to the banking system through the outright purchase of securities -- bills or coupons -- was possible as early this session.
Fed funds were trading at 5.56 percent, slightly above the Fed's current official target level of 5-1/2 percent.
